title: payload: broker.accounts
description: Response to broker.get_accounts and unsolicited push after every reconcile pass (see belphegor/reporting/account_directory.py::AccountDirectory, engine.py::_publish_broker_snapshots) — full list of accounts visible to BF's broker token. `accounts[].account_id` is the ONLY account identifier — no broker_account_id split, by design. Positions carry only `broker_ref {broker, symbol}`: BF has no instrument catalog, AFB maps the symbol to its own instrument (instrument_key) itself. Only `default_account_id` (BF's own trading account, self._account_id) is tradable in this phase — see brokers/port.py::account_id docstring; the rest are read-only until a later multi-account execution phase.

default_account_id.description: BF's single trading account (brokers/port.py::account_id) — the only account this BF instance executes orders on.

as_of.description: ISO timestamp this snapshot was assembled at.

tradable.description: True only for the account matching default_account_id — see brokers/port.py::account_id docstring. Read-only mode does not change execution; it only reflects the broker token's own readonly flag (TokenDetails.readonly).

readonly.description: TokenDetails.readonly for the broker token this account belongs to.

status.description: 'ok': freshly polled. 'stale': last known snapshot, a more recent poll failed. 'error': never successfully polled — cash/positions/equity are placeholders.

broker_fees.description: Broker commission booked on this account per trading day, a ROLLING WINDOW of the most recent days (a complete snapshot, not a delta — a lost push is healed by the next one; AFB upserts by (account_id, date) and keeps the older history itself). Absent: BF does not collect it (or the broker has no such data yet). The tariff-dependent broker commission cannot be attributed to a single deal (per contract, % of daily turnover, side-dependent), so it is account-level only; the per-trade exchange fee travels in deal.report `fills[].exchange_fee`.

date.description: Trading day, YYYY-MM-DD in BF's market.timezone (derived from the broker transaction timestamp).

value.description: Decimal string; positive = charged to the client (the broker's COMMISSION transactions are negative changes — BF flips the sign).

transaction_id.description: Broker transaction id when the day is a single transaction; omitted when several were summed.

symbol.description: Broker-side instrument locator (e.g. TICKER@MIC); the same value deals carry as target.instrument.broker_symbol.
